why: Issue #633. The rotate buttons' hover rule sits outside `@media (hover: hover)` again, where it was until this change. They are hold-to-repeat buttons pressed on a touch screen, and a touch device reports a tap as a hover and holds it, so the last button tapped keeps its lifted fill as if a hold were still running. The mutation closes the query early and restores the old top-level rule. Killed by the whole-file stray-hover case, whose exception list is now empty, and by the rotate-button case.
killedBy: hover treatment on the UI kit primitives (issue #392) scopes EVERY hover rule behind the pointer query, so a tap cannot stick
hover treatment on the UI kit primitives (issue #392) keeps the rotate buttons' hover behind the pointer query, and their press outside it (issue #633)
